=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text ha "ha"
text star "*"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note repeat writes a, k times, into one buffer (up to 256 bytes, more traps 3) and prints it
fn repeat a view uchar * k ulong to void
b = new uchar 256 0
p = ulong 0
for j ulong k
for i ulong len a
put b p get a i
p = add p 1
end
end
emit part b 0 p
emit nl
end
fn main to int
repeat ha 5
repeat star 5
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
hahahahaha
